北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 32℃ 略热，注意补水防晒哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy, feels 32℃. Stay hydrated and protected from sun!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 35℃ 闷热，多喝水，预防中暑。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and feels muggy at 35℃. Drink plenty to prevent heatstroke.
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴，体感 35℃，记得防暑降温，照顾好自己。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, feels 35℃. Remember to prevent heatstroke and take care.
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，湿度 88% 较高，出门带伞，注意防潮。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast, high humidity at 88%. Bring an umbrella and mind the dampness.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳小雨，体感 31℃ 稍热，外出记得带伞哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen has light rain, feels a bit hot at 31℃. Remember your umbrella when heading out!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 31℃，天气有些闷，记得多补水。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast, feels 31℃. It's a bit stuffy, remember to hydrate.
杭州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 33℃ 略闷热，出门做好防暑哦。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast, feels muggy at 33℃. Prepare for heat prevention when going out.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 37℃ 炎热，及时补充水分。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels scorching at 37℃. Hydrate promptly!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 36℃ 暑热，注意防暑降温哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels sweltering at 36℃. Remember heatstroke prevention and cooling down.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 38℃ 酷热，务必防晒多喝水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast, feels scorching at 38℃. Be sure to use sun protection and drink plenty.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 35℃，天气炎热，注意防晒补水。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels 35℃. It's hot, remember sun protection and hydration.
重庆.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，湿度 95% 很高，注意防潮保暖。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is overcast, humidity is very high at 95%. Mind the dampness and stay warm.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，风力 4级 较大，出门注意防风保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny with strong winds (Force 4). Mind the wind and keep warm outdoors.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，湿度 93% 较高，早晚温差大，注意添衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast, high humidity at 93%. Big temperature difference between day and night, add clothes.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，风力 4级 较大，紫外线强，记得防晒哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with strong winds (Force 4). UV is strong, remember sun protection!
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，湿度 95% 很高，能见度低，出行请慢行。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with 95% humidity. Low visibility, please drive carefully.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，风力 4级 较大，出门添衣，注意防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with strong winds (Force 4). Add clothes and mind the wind when out.
